original_s39_claim: ZERO_RISK (1.0x effective isolated leverage never approaches breach)
forensic_audit_finding: ZERO_RISK INVALIDATION: In an isolated margin account, Spot BTC capital gains are held in the Spot wallet and DO NOT automatically credit the isolated perpetual margin balance. During the 2024 bull market, BTC rallied +159% (from 42,283 to 109,588 USDT). An isolated short position of 5,000 USDT notional with 5,000 USDT initial margin suffered over 7,900 USDT in unrealized losses. Even after crediting accumulated funding (+491.27 USDT), isolated margin equity fell below Maintenance Margin Requirement (MMR = 0.40%) on 2024-11-11 at 21:15 UTC (Price: 88,378 USDT), triggering INTRABAR FORCED LIQUIDATION. Similarly, SOL carry suffered forced liquidation on 2024-03-18 at 09:45 UTC (Price: 208.0 USDT). Spot gains ensure portfolio-level solvency, but isolated margin accounts liquidate unless collateral is actively injected.
spot_perpetual_wallet_segregation_princi: Spot assets and isolated perpetual margin are completely segregated on crypto exchanges. Net portfolio delta neutrality does NOT prevent isolated margin liquidation.
